# Themes

This release ships **33 themes**: 23 dark and 10 light. Every theme is available as its own package and from `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle` under the same export name, and every theme meets WCAG AA text contrast (see [Accessibility](../accessibility/README.md)).

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to see every theme side by side.
